data.description:
## Context / Problem

Making OperationSnapshot authoritative for LLM operations (gaudy-working-mantaray) migrates `LLMConfig.from_env` call sites and threads a snapshot-derived projection through the gate/workflow entry points. The two llm modules carrying the densest from_env/composition logic are within a few lines of the hard 800-LOC module-size cap (`.github/module-size-limit.txt` = 800), so that threading would breach the CI module-size gate on first edit:

- `src/rebar/llm/config.py` = 799 (`LLMConfig.from_env` plus 14 from_env/gate references)
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py` = 796

Create headroom FIRST via behavior-preserving extraction along existing call-graph seams so the config-threading cutover lands without breaching the module-size gate. This story adds no snapshot-threading logic; it only relocates existing clusters.

## Approach

Extract cohesive existing clusters into sibling modules per the AGENTS.md module-size policy (existing seams only; target 200-500 LOC; never create a module < 100 LOC; never split mechanically):

- `llm/config.py`: move the primitive env/file reader helpers (`_env_truthy`, `_read_llm_file_table`, `_llm_str_source`, `_llm_str`, `_llm_int`, `_llm_float`, `_llm_drain_mode`) into a sibling reader module that `LLMConfig.from_env` imports.
- `llm/plan_review/__init__.py`: move the score-floor / completion-floor cluster (`_apply_floor_to_verdict`, `_score_floor_novelty`, `_maybe_apply_rising_floor`, `_apply_completion_floor_to_verdict`, `_classify_completion`, `_group_blocking_fix_units`, `_maybe_apply_completion_floor`) into a sibling `floors` module.

`LLMConfig`, `review_plan`, and the public plan_review imports keep working; only internal call sites move.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/` — extract the named clusters into new sibling modules and update imports only. Does NOT modify `src/rebar/llm/runner.py`, which is owned by the runner refactor (hurt-antigorite-genet), to avoid a collision.
- `tests/unit/` — import-path updates only; no assertion changes.

## Testing

Existing llm and plan-review suites pass unchanged (behavior-preserving). Module-size gate, per-function complexity ratchet, lint, and typecheck pass. No new CI-provider, network, or Docker dependency is introduced (portable default suite).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `llm/config.py` and `llm/plan_review/__init__.py` are each comfortably below 800 LOC (target <= 700), achieved only by extracting existing call-graph clusters into sibling modules.
- [ ] No newly created module is below 100 LOC, and no extraction is mechanical.
- [ ] Behavior is unchanged: existing llm/provider/plan-review suites pass with no edits beyond import paths.
- [ ] `llm/runner.py` is not modified here, avoiding collision with hurt-antigorite-genet.
- [ ] Module-size gate, per-function complexity ratchet, lint, and typecheck all pass.
data.title: Create llm config-threading module-size headroom before the authoritative-snapshot cutover
